t: A constitutional monarchy of the House of Savoy that united Italy between 1859 and 1870 and made Rome its capital in 1871.
Under Mussolini, appointed in 1922, it became the first Fascist dictatorship and built a colonial empire in Africa.
Defeat in the Second World War discredited the monarchy, and a referendum in 1946 replaced it with a republic.
dyk: Italian troops entered Rome in 1870 through a breach in the walls at Porta Pia, and the popes then lived as self-declared prisoners in the Vatican until the Lateran Treaty of 1929.
ev: Parliament in Turin proclaims Victor Emmanuel II king of Italy
Italian troops take Rome from the Papal States
Ethiopian forces defeat the Italian army at the Battle of Adwa
Italy enters the First World War on the side of the Entente
The March on Rome brings Benito Mussolini to power
The Lateran Treaty creates the Vatican City State
The king dismisses Mussolini and Italy signs an armistice with the Allies
A referendum abolishes the monarchy and creates the Italian Republic

f.founder: Victor Emmanuel II, with Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour
